name: Groove Quest #2
description: Kick off the long weekend with a night of techno and tech house at one of Porto's most iconic warehouse venues.
longDescription:
Groove Quest #2 is a nightlife event dedicated to techno and tech house music, presented at Hard Club. This edition marks the second installment of the Groove Quest series, establishing it as a recurring event focused on electronic music within Porto's club scene. The series aims to provide a platform for both established and emerging DJs in the genre.

Attendees can expect an energetic atmosphere suitable for dancing, extending into the early hours of the morning. The event takes place within the industrial setting of Hard Club, a venue known for its large, open spaces and robust sound systems, characteristic of a warehouse club. The audience typically consists of individuals interested in electronic dance music and club culture.

Admission to Groove Quest #2 is ticketed. Hard Club is located in the historic Ribeira district, within walking distance of São Bento train station and the Baixa area. It is also accessible via the São Bento metro station (line D), approximately a 10-minute walk. Specific accessibility information for the venue is not provided.
